chunks: Muhammad ibn Ali Majilawayh (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar narrated to us. He said: Sahl ibn Ziyad narrated to me, from Muhammad ibn al-Walid. He said: I heard Yunus ibn Yaqub narrating from Sinan ibn Turayf, from Abu Abdillah al-Sadiq (peace be upon him). He said: He said:

We are the first household whose names God proclaimed. When God created the heavens and the earth, He ordered a caller, and he called out: "I bear witness that there is no god but God" three times, "I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger of God" three times, and "I bear witness that Ali is truly the Commander of the Faithful" three times.

key_terms.أمير المؤمنين: Commander of the Faithful. The title specifically associated with Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib.
key_terms.منادي: Caller, herald. Refers to a celestial being commanded to make a divine proclamation.
key_terms.نوه: Proclaimed, mentioned prominently. Here it means that God elevated and publicized their names before all of creation.

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about the names of Ahlulbayt being proclaimed at the time of creation?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) describes a primordial event at the time of creation, when God commanded a celestial herald to proclaim the triple testimony (shahada) declaring divine unity, the prophethood of Muhammad, and the authority of Ali as Commander of the Faithful. This narration emphasizes the pre-eternal status of the Ahl al-Bayt and establishes their divine appointment from the very beginning of creation.
